leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the structure of a REST resource
Implement a generic class wrapper for typed REST API operations
Configure HTTP methods with proper type annotations for request and response
Apply type parameters to handle different resource models in the wrapper
Initialize and use the typed wrapper to fetch resources from an API endpoint
Manipulate response data with compile-time type safety
Integrate error handling with typed error responses in the wrapper
